title: URL import probes every two-segment path as a git repo; a false verdict poisons the host
description: git::detect_target shape-parses any https://host/a/b as owner/repo and, for unknown hosts, runs an 8s git ls-remote before page capture — so every ordinary web import on a new host paid that probe (git_hosts.json is full of alaskaair.com, sfpl.org, t-mobile.com…). ferrariclubofamerica.org/page/MembershipMain got a TRUE verdict, and the import then tried to clone over ssh (port 22 timeout) and landed as an error source. Fix: a bare owner/repo shape on a host without a forge-looking label (github, gitlab, gitea, git, code, scm…) is not probed; explicit /blob/ and /tree/ paths still are. Workaround in the field: add the URL with a #fragment so the shape parser skips it.
close_reason: Implemented on cld/mcp-import-feedback, PR #39; awaiting in-app pass before merge

title: URL import: flag HTTP 4xx/5xx error pages as status error
description: ingest::extract_url treats the HTTP status as advisory and lets readability decide. A 404 whose body is a full 'Page Not Found' layout (ducati.com/us/en/community/doc, parks.sonomacounty.ca.gov/support/membership) therefore imports as a ready source titled 'Ducati Page Not Found' with the error page chunked and embedded. Agents over MCP only notice by reading the title. Keep the cerebras.ai case (500 with a complete article) working: fail only when the status is 4xx/5xx AND the body looks like an error page (short text, or title matching not found / 404 / error). Carry the status onto the error reason ('HTTP 404 — the page is an error page') so status=error and error are set like the bot-wall path.
close_reason: Implemented on cld/mcp-import-feedback, PR #39; awaiting in-app pass before merge

title: Dev builds clobber the shared MCP discovery file
description: Dev instances bind mcp_port+1 (41415) to avoid colliding with the installed app, but both write the same <app-data>/mcp.json. A dev run rewrites it to 41415; after the dev app quits, the CLI and agents discover a dead port until the installed app restarts (hit live 2026-08-31: CLI errored against 41415 while nothing listened; installed app relaunch fixed it). Options: dev builds write mcp.dev.json and leave mcp.json alone, or discovery consumers fall back to the default port when the recorded pid is dead. Discovery already records pid.
close_reason: Fixed on main cabac45: dev builds write/remove mcp.dev.json instead of clobbering mcp.json; CLAUDE.md documents ALCHEMY_MCP_DISCOVERY for aiming the CLI at a dev build. Gates green; live run blocked by a concurrent pre-fix dev instance from another worktree (which demonstrated the bug once more).
